gloss: just as one is leaving; on one's way out

definitions.gloss: just as one is leaving; on one's way out
definitions.explanation: The moment of leaving to go home: at the door after a visit, or as one is leaving work. Often in {帰|かえ}り{際|ぎわ}に (just as I was leaving).

examples.japanese: {帰|かえ}り{際|ぎわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かけられた。
examples.english: Someone called out to me just as I was leaving.

examples.japanese: {帰|かえ}り{際|ぎわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}たせて→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: As I was leaving, my grandmother gave me some sweets to take home.

examples.japanese: {帰|かえ}り{際|ぎわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}まれて→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧、⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧⟦{九時|くじ}→九時：10980_kuji⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Just as I was leaving, my boss gave me an urgent job, and I ended up working until nine.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧ (to go home) and ⟦{際|きわ}→際：19355_kiwa⟧ (edge, brink), voiced to ぎわ. Mostly used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {帰|かえ}り{際|ぎわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: just as one is leaving
- {帰|かえ}り{際|ぎわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧: a parting remark

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{別|わか}れ{際|ぎわ}→別れ際：07471_wakaregiwa⟧: at parting — when two people separate
- ⟦{帰|かえ}り{道|みち}→帰り道：12447_kaerimichi⟧: the way home — the journey, not the moment of leaving
